question:

WLX : SHT :: FGJ : BCF :: ? : KPF
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic here is,

WLX : SHT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/217c7999520bcadc8ef9ea2b49015438459f18c80eb66a55a3637a57579df01b.png] 

And,

FGJ : BCF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2a62e1033059bb4a5d7f6512743c40cc144d230d6a5d61c58a41d07532aba8f.png]

? : KPF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f870c52871ad32b9537f561c547f5740a16d0cd2ca6be4f881cd8e1ff28d715.png]
